第一章 秦轩
月明星稀，百丈高的山顶上，一道黑影静静的站立着，背对着月光，远远看去，就如一匹孤狼般，给人一种生人勿进的感觉。
走得近才发现，这是一名年约十七岁左右的少年，身穿黑色紧身衣，一头长发束与脑后，随着夜风而轻轻摇摆，看起来很是干练，刀削般的脸庞，剑眉星目，虽然不算帅，但也算耐看。
“唉……”
轻轻叹了口气，少年抬头看着这片夜空，透过月光明显可以看到其眼里有着一丝莫名的落寞，身上更是散发着一股孤寂。
“八年了。”口中轻声呢喃着，少年的眼里有着一抹迷离，此时的他看上去就仿佛不存在于这个世界一般，嘴角带着浓浓的苦笑。
少年的确不属于这个世界，确切的说，是他的灵魂不属于这个世界，少年名为秦轩，原来的他，生于一颗叫做地球的美丽星球上，无奈的是，在一次电脑游戏中意外身亡。
秦轩甚至依稀还记得，那一日他下班后，如往常一般了一半后，自己的电脑竟然突然爆炸开来，只听嘭的一声，自己眼前一黑，便什么都不知道了，等到醒过来时，却是已经来到了这个陌生的世界。
幸运的是，他这一世的名字并没有改变，经过这几年的观察和学习，他也终于知道自己所在的这个世界名为神玄大陆，是一片弱肉强食，强者为尊的大陆！
在这里，只要拳头大，你就能做你喜欢的事情，实力就是硬道理，其他的，全是扯淡！
“实力吗？”握紧双拳，秦轩心里升起一丝无力感，脸上满是无奈之色，在半年之前，他或许可以自信的扬起拳头，可是现在……
似乎想到了什么，秦轩的脸色顿时变得无比难看，双眼喷射着火花，胸口剧烈的起伏着，指甲深深的扎进手心肉里，一丝腥红顺着手心滴落，在这黑夜里显得极为刺眼。
“轩儿。”就在少年沉浸在自己的愤怒中时，一声低叹从背后响起，紧接着，只见一名身穿锦袍的中年男子不知何时已经立在其身后。
突然出现的中年男子看起来与秦轩有几分相像，浑身上下自然而然的散发着一股上位者的气息，身上更是有着一股浑厚的气息流淌着，给人一种极其厚重的感觉。
转过头，待看清来人后，少年不禁一怔，旋即连忙低头道，“父亲。”
见此，秦云天不由得心里为之一痛，望着少年的眼里满是慈爱，过了许久才开口问道，“怎么？还在想那件事情吗？”
“嗯。”点了点头，少年的脸色已经变得极其平静，就仿佛一汪清泉般，再也看不出任何之前的愤怒之色。
然而，越是如此，秦云天的心情便越是沉重，一时间陷入了沉默，过了许久，才倏然叹了口气，脸上有着一抹自责，“这事怪为父，若是当初……”
“父亲，这并不怪你。”不等秦云天说完，少年连忙打断掉，当年若不是自己的父亲舍身相救，恐怕自己早已经身陨了。
念到此处，秦轩望着身前的中年男子，心里不禁一暖，前世他是孤儿，并未享受过这种亲情，脸上的神情也渐渐的柔和下来，见到父亲似乎还要说什么，连忙转移话题道，“对了父亲，您还没说您来这找我是为了什么事呢。”

见此，秦云天不由得暗自苦笑，随即脸色一肃，望着点点星光的夜空，语气凝重的问道，“你应该知道后天是个什么日子吧？”
“知道。”少年微微一怔，然后点了点头，“后天是族府大会。”
族府大会，那是整个秦家最为盛况的一次聚会，到时候不仅家族四大府主都会齐聚一堂，而且就连秦家一些闭关修炼的老家伙也会出现几个，只是，这族府大会每年都会举行一次，父亲怎么突然对自己说这个？
看着少年不解的表情，秦云天似乎早就料到了一般，轻轻一笑，不过脸上的郑重却一点也没有减少，反而愈加严肃的说道，“今年的族府大会与往年的不一样。”
“不一样？”
“没错。”秦云天点头，“老祖宗在刚才召唤过我，今年的族府大会，不仅老祖宗会亲自坐镇，而且听说还会拿出一件重宝来当做奖励。”
闻言，秦轩的面色不由得一怔，不过也愈加疑惑起来，父亲口中的老祖宗他自然知道，当年一手创立整个秦家，一身实力更是在很久以前就已经达到了凝神境，被秦家所有子弟奉为神明一般的存在。
可是这位老祖宗平时都是神龙见首不见尾，秦轩这八年来还未见过一面，两者更没有什么交集，如今父亲说这话是什么意思？
“轩儿。”见此，秦云天一笑，解释道，“重点不在于老祖宗，而是那件重宝。”
“重宝？”
“没错！”秦云天重重的点了点头，一双漆黑的眸子迸射出耀眼的光芒，声音中终于忍不住透出一股兴奋，“四大府主，老祖宗对我最为信任，而他也透露一些消息给我，这件重宝乃是他当年历练时所获，拥有了它，修炼不仅可以事半功倍，最重要的是，可以重塑经脉！”
重，重塑经脉！
一时间，秦轩仿若遭到雷劈一般，愣愣的立在那，嘴巴微张，而秦云天也没去打扰，他知道这个消息对于自己儿子来说有多重要，就连他自己，在老祖宗告诉他的时候，也兴奋了许久。
足足过了半刻钟秦轩才缓过神来，脸上依旧一片难以置信的模样，前后深深吸了两口冰冷的空气才慢慢镇定下来，“父亲，这重宝是留给此次年轻一辈比试中的第一人吧？”
“嗯。”
“那父亲认为我有机会吗？”秦轩开口问道，嘴角满是苦笑与自嘲，倒不是说他对自己的实力不自信，只能说现实往往是残酷的。
半年前还是巅峰时期的他虽说实力不错，但距离年轻一辈第一人那还是相差一大截的，而如今，自己的实力不仅没有丝毫进展，反而倒退了许多，全身经脉更是被人废了七层有余。
七层啊！如果不是自己这具身体强度极其强悍，否则怕是早已成了废物了！
自己根本没有机会！
秦云天原本兴奋的神情瞬间凝固住了，特别是看到少年嘴角处的苦笑，一颗心更是觉得一阵绞痛，暗叹一声，秦云天望着少年，眼中满是溺爱，语气轻柔且坚定的说道，“放心吧，即使为父丢了这府主的位置，丧失了这一身修为，为父也定会帮你获得这重宝！”

“父亲！”秦轩满脸惊讶，眼中却是感觉有**要往外冒出来一般，很涩，很痛。
摆了摆手，秦云天轻声一笑，也不再在这话题上纠缠，而秦轩也极有默契的不再提，两父子又交谈了许久，秦轩才将自己的父亲送走。
望着渐渐被乌云覆盖住的夜空，少年嘴角的笑容渐渐的凝固起来，脸上毫无表情，口中轻声呢喃着，“经脉，经脉。”
半年前的一个夜晚，秦轩遭受莫名的袭击，若不是因为父亲秦云天及时出现相救，恐怕早已身亡，可尽管如此，全身经脉依旧被废了七层。
经脉，乃是人的本源，就仿佛大树要有树根一般，树依靠根来汲取泥土中的养分，若是树没有了树根，那也就活不下去了，同理，若是一个人连经脉都没有了，轻则修为全无，一辈子无法修炼，重则身亡，埋入地底。
幸运的是，秦轩还有三层的经脉处于完好，虽然修为倒退，但依旧能修炼，只是进度却是极为缓慢，与以前相比，一个是光速，一个则是龟速。
“不管你是谁，终有一天，我定会将你揪出来，挫骨扬灰！”紧紧的握着双拳，秦轩心中咆哮着，双眼射出夺人心魄的光芒，令人畏惧，不敢直视，身上更是散发着一股冰冷的气息，明明没有任何能量波动，却仿佛来自九幽炼狱一般，令周围的温度降了好几度。
不过秦轩也明白，凭借他现在的实力和身体状况，别说揪出那个人了，就算现在那个人站在他面前，恐怕他也无能为力，而他唯一的希望，便是这次家族大会，秦家老祖宗的那一件重宝！
“修复经脉的重宝！”
少年目光灼灼，心中升起无限的渴望，自己一定要获得这件重宝，特别是想起刚才父亲的那番话，秦轩心中的想法愈加的坚定，不只为了自己，还有为自己的父亲！
这半年来，因为自己的原因，父亲可没少受白眼，特别是在其他三位府主面前，更是抬不起头来，虽然父亲不说，可是自己可都看在眼里。
因此，他也努力过，试图修复经脉，可是最后，却是一点成果都没有！
这次，是唯一的希望！
错过了，将不会再有！
只是，在半年前，秦家年轻一辈的第一人早已达到了炼体九重的修为，如今怕是早已突破，成为气海镜的强者，而自己，这半年已经倒退到了炼体三重，两者根本不是一个层次的。
其中的机会，微乎其微。
“我秦轩，绝对不会认输的！”
少年的脸色一片坚定，仿佛就算前面是刀山火海，他也会毫不犹豫，坚定不移的踏出去！
也就在这时，一阵剧痛猛的袭向少年的胸口，宛若有人硬生生要将其胸口从中间撕成两半一般……
(新书上传，求

Chapter 1 Qin Xuan
The moon is sparse, and on the top of a hundred-foot-high mountain, a black shadow stands quietly, with its back to the moonlight. From a distance, it looks like a lone wolf, giving people a feeling that no strangers are allowed to enter.
When I got closer, I realized that this was a boy of about seventeen years old, wearing a black tights, with long hair tied to the back of his head, swaying gently in the night wind. He looked very capable, with a knife-like face and sharp eyebrows and starry eyes. Although he was not handsome, he was still good-looking.
"Alas..."
Sighing softly, the young man looked up at the night sky. Through the moonlight, he could clearly see an inexplicable loneliness in his eyes, and there was even more loneliness exuding from his body.
"Eight years." He murmured softly, and there was a blur in the young man's eyes. At this time, he looked as if he did not exist in this world, with a thick bitter smile on his lips.
The boy does not belong to this world. To be precise, his soul does not belong to this world. The boy's name is Qin Xuan. It turns out that he was born on a beautiful planet called Earth. Unfortunately, he died accidentally in a computer game.
Qin Xuan even vaguely remembered that after he got off work that day, half way through as usual, his computer suddenly exploded. He heard a bang, his vision went dark, and he didn't know anything. When he woke up, he had already arrived in this strange world.
Fortunately, his name in this life has not changed. After several years of observation and study, he finally knew that the world he was in was called Shenxuan Continent, a continent where the weak preyed on the strong and the strong were respected!
Here, as long as your fists are big, you can do what you like. Strength is the last word, and everything else is nonsense!
"Strength?" Clenching his fists, Qin Xuan felt a sense of powerlessness in his heart, and his face was full of helplessness. Half a year ago, he might have been able to raise his fists confidently, but now...
As if he thought of something, Qin Xuan's face suddenly became extremely ugly, his eyes were shooting sparks, his chest was heaving violently, his nails dug deeply into the flesh of his palms, and a trace of blood dripped down his palms, which looked extremely dazzling in the dark night.
"Xuan'er." Just when the young man was immersed in his own anger, a low sigh sounded from behind, and then, a middle-aged man wearing a brocade robe was seen standing behind him at some point.
The middle-aged man who suddenly appeared looked somewhat similar to Qin Xuan. His whole body naturally exuded the aura of a superior person, and there was a thick aura flowing around him, giving people an extremely heavy feeling.
Turning his head, the young man couldn't help but be startled after seeing the person clearly, and then he quickly lowered his head and said, "Father."
Seeing this, Qin Yuntian couldn't help but feel pain in his heart. He looked at the young man with eyes full of love. After a long time, he asked, "What? Are you still thinking about that matter?"
"Yes." Nodding, the young man's face had become extremely calm, like a clear spring, and there was no trace of the previous anger.
However, the more this happened, the heavier Qin Yuntian's mood became, and he fell into silence for a while. After a long time, he sighed suddenly, with a trace of self-blame on his face, "This is my father's fault. If it was originally..."
"Father, this is not your fault." Before Qin Yuntian could finish speaking, the young man quickly interrupted. If his father hadn't sacrificed his life to save him, he might have died long ago.
Thinking of this, Qin Xuan looked at the middle-aged man in front of him and couldn't help but feel warm in his heart. In his previous life, he was an orphan and had never enjoyed this kind of family affection. The expression on his face gradually softened. When he saw his father, he seemed to want to say something more. He quickly changed the subject and said, "By the way, father, you haven't said why you came here to see me."
Seeing this, Qin Yuntian couldn't help but smile bitterly to himself, then his face became solemn, he looked at the starry night sky and asked in a solemn tone, "You should know the day after tomorrow."What day is it? "
"Know. "The young man was startled for a moment, then nodded, "The day after tomorrow is the clan government meeting. "
The clan conference is the most grand gathering of the entire Qin family. Not only will the four major palace heads of the family gather together, but even some old guys from the Qin family who are practicing in seclusion will show up. However, this clan conference is held once a year. Why did my father suddenly say this to himself?
Looking at the young man's puzzled expression, Qin Yuntian seemed to have expected it, and smiled softly, but the solemnity on his face did not diminish at all. Instead, he said more seriously, "This year's clan conference is different from previous years. "
"no the same? "
"That's right. "Qin Yuntian nodded, "The ancestors summoned me just now. Not only will the ancestors personally attend this year's clan conference, but I heard that they will also give out a valuable treasure as a reward. "
Hearing this, Qin Xuan's face couldn't help but startled, but he also became more and more confused. He naturally knew that the ancestor his father mentioned was the one who founded the entire Qin family back then. His strength had reached the level of concentration a long time ago, and he was regarded as a god-like existence by all the children of the Qin family.
But this ancestor is usually a dragon that sees the beginning but not the end. Qin Xuan has not seen each other in the past eight years, and the two have no intersection. What does his father mean by this now?
"Xuan'er. Seeing this, Qin Yuntian smiled and explained, "The point is not about the ancestors, but the important treasure." "
"Heavy treasure? "
"That's right! "Qin Yuntian nodded heavily, a pair of dark eyes bursting with dazzling light, and finally couldn't help but reveal a sense of excitement in his voice, "The ancestor of the four palace masters trusted me the most, and he also revealed some information to me. This important treasure was obtained by him during his training. With it, cultivation can not only get twice the result with half the effort, but most importantly, it can reshape the meridians! "
Heavy, reshape the meridians!
For a moment, Qin Xuan stood there blankly, as if struck by lightning, with his mouth slightly open, but Qin Yuntian did not bother him. He knew how important this news was to his son, and even he himself was excited for a long time when his ancestor told him.
It took a full quarter of an hour before Qin Xuan came to his senses, but his face was still in disbelief. He took two deep breaths of cold air before calming down, "Father, this treasure is reserved for the first person in this competition among the younger generation, right? "
"Um. "
"Does dad think I have a chance? "Qin Xuan asked, with a wry smile and self-deprecation on his lips. It's not that he is not confident in his own strength, it can only be said that reality is often cruel.
Although his strength was good when he was at his peak half a year ago, he was still far behind the number one among the younger generation. But now, not only has his strength not improved at all, but he has regressed a lot, and his meridians have been crippled by more than seven levels.
Seventh floor! If it weren't for the extremely strong strength of my body, I would have become a waste!
I have no chance at all!
Qin Yuntian's originally excited expression froze in an instant, especially when he saw the bitter smile at the corner of the young man's mouth, his heart felt cramped. He sighed secretly, Qin Yuntian looked at the young man, his eyes full of doting, and said softly and firmly, "Don't worry, even if you lose the position of the master of the palace and lose this cultivation, you will definitely help you obtain this important treasure! "
"Father! "Qin Xuan's face was full of surprise, but his eyes felt like something was about to come out. It was very astringent and painful.
After waving his hand, Qin Yuntian smiled softly and stopped entangled on this topic. Qin Xuan also tacitly agreed not to mention it. The two father and son talked for a long time before Qin Xuan sent his father away.
Looking at the night sky that was gradually covered by dark clouds, the smile at the corner of the young man's mouth gradually solidified. His face was expressionless and he murmured softly, "Meridians, meridians."
One night half a year ago, Qin Xuan suffered an inexplicable attack. If it weren't for his father Qin Yuntian's timely rescue, he would have died long ago. However, despite this, the meridians throughout his body were still disabled for seven levels.
Meridians are the origin of human beings, just like a big tree must have roots. The tree relies on roots to absorb nutrients from the soil. If the tree does not have roots, it will not be able to survive. In the same way, if a person does not even have meridians, he will have no cultivation at all and will be unable to practice for a lifetime, or he will die and be buried underground.
Fortunately, Qin Xuan still has three layers of meridians intact. Although his cultivation has regressed, he can still practice, but the progress is extremely slow. Compared with before, one is at the speed of light and the other is at the speed of a turtle.
"No matter who you are, one day I will definitely dig you out and crush you to ashes! "Clenching his fists tightly, Qin Xuan roared in his heart, his eyes shot out a soul-stirring light that was so frightening that he dared not look directly at him. His body exuded an icy aura. There was no energy fluctuation, but it seemed to come from the Nine Nether Purgatory, which made the surrounding temperature drop several degrees.
However, Qin Xuan also understands that with his current strength and physical condition, let alone finding out that person, even if that person is standing in front of him now, he may not be able to do anything. And his only hope is this family meeting, the important treasure of the ancestors of the Qin family!
"An important treasure for repairing meridians! "
The young man's eyes were burning, and infinite desire arose in his heart. He must obtain this important treasure. Especially when he thought of his father's words just now, Qin Xuan became more determined, not only for himself, but also for his father!
In the past six months, due to his own reasons, my father has been looked down upon. Especially in front of the other three palace masters, he couldn't hold his head up. Although his father didn't say it, he could see it.
Therefore, he also tried hard to repair the meridians, but in the end, there was no result at all!
This time, it's the only hope!
If you miss it, you will never see it again!
However, half a year ago, the first member of the younger generation of the Qin family had already reached the ninth level of body refining. Now he may have broken through and become a strong Qi Sea Mirror. However, he has regressed to the third level of body refining in the past six months. The two are not at the same level.
The chances are slim.
"I, Qin Xuan, will never admit defeat! "
The young man's face was firm, as if even if there was a mountain of swords and a sea of fire ahead of him, he would not hesitate and step out unswervingly!
At this moment, a sharp pain hit the young man's chest, as if someone was trying to tear his chest in half from the middle...
